failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 40°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Deposition of reaction by-products on heat exchanger surfaces
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement regular cleaning schedule and monitor heat exchanger performance

failure_modes.cause: Particulate formation due to incomplete dissolution of reactants
failure_modes.mitigation: Ensure complete dissolution of reactants before entering the flow system

Conduct heat exchanger performance test with simulated fouling conditions
Test dissolution of reactants at operating conditions to ensure complete solubility
